children.value: > Fact From Story: He revealed that he made a friendship bracelet, a fan tradition at her concerts, with his number on it to give to her, seemingly expressing his interest in Swift.

> > Fact From Story: Kelce said he did not have the chance to meet the 12-time Grammy winner because "she doesn't talk before or after her shows because she has to save her voice for the 44 songs she sings ... She doesn't meet anybody".
> > > Fact From Story: Kelce announced that he went to Swift's highly anticipated concert, but said he did not have the chance to meet the 12-time Grammy winner.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People often make an effort to meet someone they are interested in.
> > Fact From Story: Kelce announced that he went to Swift's highly anticipated concert, but said he did not have the chance to meet the 12-time Grammy winner.
> > > Fact From Story: Kelce said he was "taking a page out of Taylor Swift's book." | Fact From Story
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People take inspiration from people they admire. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People often make an effort to meet someone they are interested in.
> Fact From Story: Kelce announced that he went to Swift's highly anticipated concert, but said he did not have the chance to meet the 12-time Grammy winner.
> > Fact From Story: When his brother asked if it was his jersey number or his phone number, Kelce replied, "you know which one." | Fact From Story
> > > > Fact From Story: Kelce made a friendship bracelet to give to the newcomers at a camp for NFL tight ends. | Fact From Story
> > > > Commonsense Knowledge: People are more likely to give a jersey number to fellow players than to someone they are romantically interested in. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People give their phone number to someone they want to communicate with. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Commonsense Knowledge: People often make an effort to meet someone they are interested in.
